sloka: तस्य तं निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा शक्रो देवेश्वरस्तदा ।रथस्थः समरस्थस्तान्देवान्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।। ७.२९.१२ ॥
transliteration: tasya taṁ niścayaṁ jñātvā śakro deveśvarastadā ।rathasthaḥ samarasthastāndevānvākyamathābravīt ।। 7.29.12 ॥

translations.english: Then, Indra, the lord of gods, having understood his (Ravana's) determination, spoke these words to the gods who were also present in the battlefield, while he stood in his chariot.
